rejected_R01_v1.note: north star again. Diagnosis: our own wording carried the cue - see root_cause.

root_cause_of_the_star_misses: Not model stubbornness. The geometry string said 'the up and down points a little longer' and the shared rule said 'two long and two short' - which is the construction of a north star (two long arms, two short, minor rays between). We were describing the banned shape while banning it, in all 50 prompts. Replaced with four points of EQUAL length on a plus, diagonals explicitly empty; R01 and N01 then passed from text alone, with no reference image. prompts.py asserts the cue phrases can never return.
